llm.summary: This classroom-coaching skill is transparently focused on helping teachers design classroom interaction and does not show hidden execution, data theft, or destructive behavior.

dimensions.detail: The skill is strongly localized to Simplified Chinese and mainland China K-12 curriculum and safety defaults; this is disclosed in shared/platform-conventions.md and is coherent for that deployment, but non-mainland-China deployments should localize language, curriculum, laws, and crisis contacts before use.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package contains Markdown and JSON schema files only; no executable files, dependency installation scripts, network retrieval, shell commands, or tool-wrapping behavior were found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Some trigger examples are broad, but the surrounding instructions clearly scope use to teacher classroom preparation or reflection and provide explicit handoffs for lesson planning, exam design, student analysis, homework, and lab safety.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill uses platform memory/workspace concepts and writes interactionLogs, but it limits writes to teacher-confirmed aggregate classroom observations, avoids student names in those logs, and provides view, correction, deletion, pause, sharing-control, and export controls.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The artifacts consistently describe a teacher-facing Chinese K-12 classroom interaction coach that reads lesson plans, class profile, student tiers, and weakness summaries, then helps design questions, grouping, timing, cold-call alternatives, and post-class observations.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this only for a Simplified Chinese, mainland China K-12 teacher workflow unless you first localize the curriculum assumptions, legal references, and crisis-support contacts. Review the workspace-memory settings because it can read class context and create teacher-confirmed classroom interaction records, although the artifacts instruct it not to store individual student names in those logs.
llm.findings:
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese-only language and mainland China locale assumptions are real, but the artifacts explicitly state the library is designed for mainland China Chinese K-12 use and require localization before other deployments, so this is disclosed and purpose-aligned rather than hidden or deceptive.
[SQP-1] expected: The trigger phrases are somewhat broad, but they are embedded in a teacher classroom-coaching skill with adjacent-request exclusions and handoff rules; this does not create a material security concern.
